profile.name: Stephen Cheng
profile.title: Technical Lead | Agentic AI & ERP Solutions Architect

professionalSummary: Senior engineer and technical lead with 10+ years of experience spanning enterprise ERP systems (D365 BC / NAV) and a deliberate specialisation in Applied AI since 2022. Practitioner-level expertise in agentic system design — including RAG pipeline engineering, HITL (Human-in-the-Loop) workflow orchestration, context engineering, prompt harness design, and multi-agent loop architecture. Led engineering teams at Kydon Group and Vincere.io, owning delivery from architecture through to production across both product and integration domains. Certified Microsoft Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect and Claude Certified Architect, with deep roots in D365 BC implementation, OData/REST integration, and Azure Cloud.

experiences.role: Agentic AI & D365 BC Technical Architect
bullets: Dedicated this period to deep Agentic AI mastery — earning both the Microsoft Certified: Agentic AI Business Solutions Architect and the Claude Certified Architect – Foundations (CCA-F) credentials — and applying that expertise directly in client-facing AI solution design from day one.

Architected production-ready agentic systems: RAG pipelines surfacing ERP knowledge bases in conversational AI interfaces, HITL approval loops integrating AI recommendations into Business Central workflow chains, and multi-agent orchestration using LangChain/LangGraph and the Anthropic Claude SDK.

Engineered context engineering and loop engineering patterns to manage token budgets, control agentic exit conditions, and prevent runaway loops — then validated output quality through structured prompt harnesses and LLM evaluation frameworks before client deployment.

Continued core D365 BC consulting in parallel: engineered OData/Azure Function integrations, built resilient REST API layers for CRM and logistics sync, and established Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines with AL Test Toolkit for zero-regression deployments.

experiences.role: Senior AL Developer & ERP Integration Lead
bullets: Led the technical implementation and evolution of D365 BC at CADDi — an AI-native manufacturing platform — extending the ERP with custom AL modules tightly coupled to AI-driven parts procurement and cost-estimation workflows.

Drove internal AI capability building across 2023–2025: ran LLM-assisted demand-classification pilots, built RAG-based retrieval over manufacturing knowledge bases, and engineered prompt pipelines connecting Business Central operational data to AI inference services — gaining hands-on agentic AI experience in a production AI environment.

Applied early context engineering and harness engineering practices to manage LLM prompt quality and evaluate output accuracy for internal tools, establishing the team's first structured AI quality standards.

Built resilient RESTful API layers synchronising Business Central with internal microservices and AI services, achieving 99.95% uptime SLA and real-time operational visibility across production and procurement.

Managed two engineering teams sequentially over the two-year tenure: led a 5-person Vietnamese engineering team in year one, then stepped up to manage a 7-person cross-border team spanning Singapore and Vietnam in year two — owning hiring, performance reviews, sprint planning, and technical direction for both cohorts.

Drove stakeholder alignment across product, business, and regional leadership in both Singapore and Vietnam, translating complex technical trade-offs into structured decision frameworks that accelerated executive buy-in on major platform architecture decisions.

Spearheaded enterprise system integrations connecting proprietary learning platforms with corporate ERP applications (including D365 BC) via semantic API layers, supporting 10K+ concurrent users with event-driven architecture that reduced data-synchronisation latency by 60%.
Implemented enterprise-wide design systems and standardised API contracts across both teams, reducing cross-team integration overhead by 30% and embedding a documentation-first engineering culture.

Championed the organisation's first ML-assisted content personalisation exploration in 2022 — the genesis of a personal specialisation in applied AI and agentic systems that has since been formalised through industry certifications.

Managed direct reports as technical lead of the integrations workstream — providing hands-on mentorship, structured code reviews, and career development support while simultaneously defining API contracts and owning architectural decisions across the team's delivery.

Orchestrated scalable data pipelines between Vincere's high-volume recruitment CRM and client ERP and financial systems — including Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central — automating ETL processes that maintained high-fidelity data synchronisation at scale.

Engineered multi-tenant API integrations with stringent data-privacy boundaries and high-availability guarantees, establishing cross-region compliance patterns that became the platform's integration standard for new enterprise accounts.

Collaborated closely with product and customer-success teams to translate complex client integration requirements into reusable connector frameworks, significantly compressing time-to-onboard for enterprise accounts globally.

Developed and maintained complex transaction processing systems with a focus on fault-tolerance and secure data handling, foundational skills highly applicable to robust ERP and AI system architecture.
Conducted rigorous testing and formal verification of data processing logic to prevent vulnerabilities, maintaining an exceptional standard of code quality through TDD.
Gained deep expertise in handling scalable databases and optimising query performance to ensure sub-100ms response times for critical business applications.
Contributed to the development and customisation of enterprise-level applications, integrating various backend microservices and databases.
Optimised data querying and system rendering pathways, successfully reducing system latency and enhancing overall application efficiency for large-scale enterprise clients.
Participated actively in Agile delivery pods, driving the implementation of CI/CD practices to automate release processes and minimise deployment downtime.
